blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The government should accelerate the shift from costly diesel power plants to solar with battery storage systems in off-grid areas. This change will cut power bills and prevent on-grid consumers from shouldering rising subsidy costs. According to a report from the Asian Photovoltaic Industry Association (APVIA), replacing diesel facilities with smaller solar power systems could significantly reduce costs passed on to consumers connected to the country’s grid network.
